title: Field quoting & estimating tools
tagline: Quote on-site from a tablet. Send a branded PDF before you leave the driveway.
forWho: Trades and home-services businesses that measure, price and quote in the customer's home: blinds, cabinetry, flooring, HVAC, landscaping.
youGet: Measurement entry designed for a phone or tablet, with live pricing as you type
Your own pricing rules (minimums, per-metre, per-panel, options and add-ons)
Branded estimate and invoice PDFs emailed to the customer
A customer link to review, request changes and confirm online

example.text: Measure Blinds prices ten blind types by formula and lets Blinds Nisa customers confirm by email.
